description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the ListImages operation for viewing the image data list
description_zh: 本文档介绍查看图片数据列表ListImages的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imgsearch list-images --db-name default --token 2 --offset 1 --limit 50 --order asc --entity-id-prefix U1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListImages

parameters.help_en: The pagination method that combines Offset and Limit supports only the first 2,000 records. If the number of records exceeds 2,000, use the Token returned in the previous request as the parameter for requesting the next page
parameters.help_zh: Offset和Limit组合的分页方式只支持前2000条记录。当超过2000条时，需要使用上一次请求返回的Token作为请求下一页的参数
parameters.name: token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排列方式。包括升序（asc）和降序（desc）
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the sample ID
parameters.name: entity_id_prefix
